name: Almotriptan

examples.title: Evaluation of the Efficacy of Almotriptan and Ubrogepant for the Acute Treatment of Migraine

summary: Official warnings for almotriptan note serious heart-related problems, including heart attacks (acute myocardial infarction) and life-threatening irregular heartbeats [3]. The drug label also strongly advises against giving these tablets to patients predicted to have hidden coronary artery disease, which affects blood flow to the heart [3]. Additionally, results from a small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave the drug a medium risk score of 64 for the liver and a low risk score of 50 for the heart [M].
